summary: xAI announced that Interactive Brokers has integrated Grok into its trading platform, letting clients link accounts to use Grok for portfolio analysis, scenario modeling, research, and generating order instructions.

categories.reason: A brokerage is embedding Grok directly into its trading platform for account analysis and order generation, changing the product offered to its clients.
categories.quote: Interactive Brokers now integrates with Grok, bringing powerful AI directly into your trading experience — portfolio analysis, scenario modeling, research, and order instructions.
